notes.content: Program Description The School of Engineering offers a Bachelor’s of Science degree in Civil Engineering with emphasis on design, maintenance, rehabilitation, and construction of infrastructure projects. This program is designed for individuals who are planning to advance their knowledge in Civil Engineering and follow career paths in industry, government, consulting, and academia. Special attention is given to working professionals with classes offered mainly at times convenient to students. Students will take required courses in Structural Analysis, Structural Design, Engineering Materials, Geotechnical Engineering, Computer Applications in Infrastructure, Transportation Engineering, Highway and Pavement Design, Sustainability and Green Building. Also, issues in engineering ethics, building design codes, and life cycle analysis are covered. Students will have a broad choice of electives from courses in construction management and engineering to customize their expertise.
notes.contentHtml:
Program Description

The School of Engineering offers a Bachelor’s of Science degree in Civil Engineering with emphasis on design, maintenance, rehabilitation, and construction of infrastructure projects. This program is designed for individuals who are planning to advance their knowledge in Civil Engineering and follow career paths in industry, government, consulting, and academia.


Special attention is given to working professionals with classes offered mainly at times convenient to students. Students will take required courses in Structural Analysis, Structural Design, Engineering Materials, Geotechnical Engineering, Computer Applications in Infrastructure, Transportation Engineering, Highway and Pavement Design, Sustainability and Green Building. Also, issues in engineering ethics, building design codes, and life cycle analysis are covered. Students will have a broad choice of electives from courses in construction management and engineering to customize their expertise.

notes.content: Please Note that the CSU EAST BAY COLLEGE OF SCIENCE does not accept ONLINE LABS taken for transfer as equivalent to CSUEB Lab courses. Only "In Person" Labs conducted in a College Laboratory setting will be considered equivalent to the CSU East Bay Lab course. Students who took an ONLINE LAB will be expected to retake the lab in person for major credit. This only affects transfer students within the College of Science majors.
